description: Runs the Phase 14 request application's original handlers and services against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor; the coordinator plays the HTTP client.

addOrderItems.description: One two-row INSERT with database-generated keys, then the 201 response.

addOrderItemsIdempotent.description: The same two-row INSERT keyed by (request, sku), ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

settlePayment.description: INSERT a payment and mark the order paid in one transaction, inside withRetry (retries on any error).

settlePaymentOnce.description: The same gated by UPDATE ... WHERE status = 'pending' RETURNING.
